summary_en: FY3/27 H1 dividend raised to ¥50/share (¥40 regular + ¥10 centennial commemoration) from prior forecast ¥35/share. FY3/27 full-year dividend to ¥95/share (prior ¥80/share). Progressive dividend policy applied; FY3/26 actual was ¥72/share (¥33 H1 + ¥39 year-end).
title_en: Notification regarding modification of earnings forecast for FY3/27 H1 cumulative period and full-year consolidated earnings forecast, and modification of dividend forecast (dividend increase and 100th anniversary commemoration dividend)
translation_en_brief:
Takebishi Corporation has revised its dividend forecast for FY3/27 following stronger-than-expected earnings driven by demand expansion in AI and semiconductor-related fields. The company announced a dividend increase at its H1 settlement (December 2026) and the introduction of a centennial commemoration dividend.

H1 dividend is raised from the prior forecast of ¥35/share to ¥50/share, comprising ¥40/share regular dividend (an increase of ¥5/share) and ¥10/share centennial commemoration dividend. Full-year FY3/27 dividend is now forecast at ¥95/share (up from prior ¥80/share), versus FY3/26 actual of ¥72/share (¥33 H1 + ¥39 year-end). The company applies a progressive dividend policy and considers earnings and financial condition comprehensively when setting distributions. The centennial dividend recognises the 100th anniversary milestone reached in April 2026 and expresses gratitude to shareholders and business partners.
